apiDocs.title: my-finance API
apiDocs.description: Interactive reference for the my-finance REST API. To call protected endpoints: 1) run POST /api/v1/auth/login, 2) copy the accessToken from the response, 3) click Authorize and paste it. Access tokens are short-lived; log in again when calls start returning 401.

security.bearer: Access token (JWT) returned by POST /api/v1/auth/login or /api/v1/auth/register.

operations.login: Log in and get an access token
operations.loginDescription: Returns a bearer access token. Use it with the Authorize button to call protected endpoints.
operations.logout: Log out and revoke the current session
operations.logoutDescription: Revokes the session identified by the refreshToken cookie. No access token is needed, so logout works after the access token has expired; do not send an Authorization header, because an expired or invalid one is rejected with 401 before logout runs. Returns 204 and clears the cookie.
operations.listCreditCards: List credit cards linked to your PAN
operations.getCardStatements: Get a card and its last 12 months of statements
operations.getCardStatementsDescription: One statement per billing cycle issued in the current month or the 11 before it, newest first, preferring the email that had the PDF. Download each one with GET /api/v1/mailboxes/statements/{statementId}/download. A card not linked to your PAN returns 404.
operations.resolveMailbox: Check whether an email address can be linked
operations.connectMailboxDescription: Returns the provider consent URL to open in the browser. Also sets a short-lived HttpOnly cookie that the OAuth callback must receive from the same browser.
operations.mailboxOAuthCallback: OAuth redirect target for mailbox linking
operations.mailboxOAuthCallbackDescription: Called by Google or Microsoft after consent, not by API clients. Always clears the linking cookie and redirects to the profile page (/profile) with linked=1 on success or error=<code> on failure.
operations.syncMailbox: Queue a sync of a linked mailbox
operations.unlinkMailbox: Unlink a mailbox and revoke its access
operations.downloadStatementDescription: Fetches the statement attachment live from the linked mailbox that received it; nothing is stored. Rate limited to 20 per hour.

schemas.accessToken: Bearer token for the Authorization header.
schemas.panMasked: PAN with the four digits hidden, e.g. ABCDE####F.
schemas.emailMasked: Mailbox address with most of the local part hidden.
schemas.passwordHint: The bank's description of the statement password format, taken from the email. Never the password itself.
schemas.dueDate: Null only when the statement has nothing due.
schemas.cardNumberLast4: Last 4 digits of the card. Null when the bank's statement emails never show them; cardName names the card instead.
schemas.cardName: The card's name from the statement email subject (e.g. Pixel Play, Amazon Pay). Null when the subject names none.
schemas.cardStatus: INACTIVE: an ACTIVE card with no statement in the 70 days before its mailbox's last sync. Otherwise the stored status.
schemas.cardMailboxIds: Ids of the linked mailboxes (as in GET /mailboxes) this card's statements were found in. Empty when it has none.
schemas.downloadAvailable: Whether the statement email had a PDF that can be downloaded.
schemas.syncAvailableAt: When a manual sync is allowed again; null when it is allowed now.

responses.panNotRegistered: No PAN is linked to this account
responses.mailboxNotLinkable: Request body failed validation, or the mailbox provider is not supported

responses.syncTooFrequent: A sync is already running or ran a few minutes ago
responses.oauthRedirect: Redirect to the Credit Cards page
responses.statementFile: The statement file as an attachment
responses.statementUnavailable: Statement not found, or its email or attachment is no longer in the mailbox
